question: tools/branches-editor.html, the tool CLAUDE.md tells everyone to use for editing branches.json, carries a full embedded copy of branches.json inside itself as a starting snapshot. Leave the behaviour alone and keep refreshing the snapshot by hand whenever branches.json changes. No code change, but it depends on every future editor remembering, and the failure is silent when they forget
answer: Recommended option (1): the editor now refuses to Download until a real branches.json has been loaded that session. Answered and implemented directly by Rishi in a Cowork session on 2026-08-09 rather than left for a worker run, since Rishi is stepping away for the next 24 hours and wanted it closed out immediately. Download now checks a loadedFromFile flag, set only by a successful Load; Save shows an explanatory alert and returns early if it is false, instead of silently exporting the bundled snapshot. All five checkers re-run clean afterwards (177 pages, 262 text files, 16 branches, 0 failures).
note: Nothing is blocked by this and nothing about the current data is wrong: the snapshot has been brought level with branches.json as part of this run. It is raised because it is the one route by which a single careless click could undo the whole audit backlog's data work on the single source of truth, and because CLAUDE.md's own rule is that stale copies of branches.json are a hazard.
